title: Supply Run to Dalhurst
description: Half the camp's saws are past sharpening and Tharin's smith has no steel to spare this deep in the season. Halvard in Dalhurst has held a tool shipment since summer, and it is paid for now. Bring it back before somebody loses fingers.

objectives.description: Travel west to Dalhurst, past the Crossroads
Collect the tool shipment from Halvard
Get the tools back to Tharin

notes: Threat: Elder Moor's felling crews working dull tools toward an accident. Giver motive: second of Tharin's four trust tests - sending a stranger to collect a paid-for shipment from a stranger in Dalhurst. Consequence unwired; recorded for a later pass.
